q: The Kolmogorov structure function h_x(α) measures, for a string x of length n, the minimum description length K(S) of a model S ∋ x such that K(x|S) ≤ α (x appears random in S). The graph of h_x is:
opts: A non-increasing staircase from K(x) (at α=0) to K({x}) ≈ n (at α=K(x))
exp: The structure function h_x(α) = min{K(S) : x∈S, log|S| ≤ α} is non-increasing in α: more allowance for randomness within S allows more structured (shorter description) models. The 'meaningful information' of x is the initial steep decrease of h_x before it flattens.
